title: षष्ठोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Yudhishthira, disguised as a Brahmin with dice tied in his garment, presents himself at Virata's court as Kanka, a former companion of Yudhishthira skilled in dice. Virata welcomes him warmly and makes him his friend and companion with every honour.
summary.kn: ಬಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದಾಳಗಳನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಂಡ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣವೇಷದ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನು, ದ್ಯೂತನಿಪುಣ, ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಸಂಗಾತಿ ಕಂಕನೆಂದು ವಿರಾಟನ ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತನ್ನನ್ನು ಪರಿಚಯಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ವಿರಾಟನು ಹಾರ್ದಿಕವಾಗಿ ಸ್ವಾಗತಿಸಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಗೌರವದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮಿತ್ರ ಸಂಗಾತಿಯನ್ನಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: वस्त्र में पासे बाँधे ब्राह्मण-वेशधारी युधिष्ठिर विराट की सभा में स्वयं को कङ्क बताते हैं, जो युधिष्ठिर के पुराने साथी और द्यूत में निपुण हैं। विराट उनका हार्दिक स्वागत करते हैं और पूरे सम्मान के साथ उन्हें अपना मित्र और साथी बनाते हैं।
summary.te: వస్త్రంలో పాచికలు కట్టుకున్న బ్రాహ్మణవేషధారి యుధిష్ఠిరుడు, ద్యూతనిపుణుడు, యుధిష్ఠిరుని పాత సహచరుడు కంకుడనని విరాటుని సభలో తనను పరిచయం చేసుకుంటాడు. విరాటుడు ఆప్యాయంగా స్వాగతించి అన్ని గౌరవాలతో అతనిని మిత్రుడు, సహచరునిగా చేసుకుంటాడు.
summary.ta: ஆடையில் பகடைகளைக் கட்டிய அந்தண வேடமிட்ட யுதிஷ்டிரர், சூதில் வல்ல, யுதிஷ்டிரரின் முன்னாள் தோழன் கங்கன் என்று விராடனின் சபையில் தம்மை அறிமுகப்படுத்துகிறார். விராடன் அன்புடன் வரவேற்று எல்லா மரியாதையுடனும் அவரைத் தன் நண்பனும் தோழனுமாக்குகிறான்.
summary.ml: ചൂതുകളിക്കാരൻ വസ്ത്രത്തിൽ കെട്ടിവെച്ച ബ്രാഹ്മണനായി യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ വിരാടന്റെ സദസ്സിൽ എത്തുന്നു. യുധിഷ്ഠിരന്റെ പഴയ കൂട്ടുകാരനും ചൂതിൽ മിടുക്കനുമായ കങ്കനെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം സ്വയം പരിചയപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു. വിരാടൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ഊഷ്മളമായി സ്വീകരിച്ച്, എല്ലാ ബഹുമാനത്തോടെയും തന്റെ സുഹൃത്തും കൂട്ടാളിയുമാക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 4.6; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Dec  1 2011

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततो विराटं प्रथमं युधिष्ठिरो
राजा सभायामुपविष्टमाव्रजत् ।
वैडूर्यरूपान्प्रतिमुच्य काञ्चना-
नक्षान्स कक्षे परिगृह्य वाससा ॥

meaning.en: Then King Yudhishthira was the first to approach Virata as he sat in his court, carrying dice of beryl and gold tied up in a cloth at his side.

verses.text:
नराधिपो राष्ट्रपतिं यशस्विनं
महायशाः कौरववंशवर्धनः ।
महानुभावो नरराजसत्कृतो
दुरासदस्तीक्ष्णविषो यथोरगः ॥

meaning.en: That illustrious king, increaser of the Kuru line, a man of great bearing honored among kings, approached the famous lord of the land, formidable as a snake with sharp venom.

verses.text:
बलेन रूपेण नरर्षभो महा-
नथार्चिरूपेण यथामरस्तथा ।
महाभ्रजालैरिव संवृतो रवि-
र्यथानलो भस्मवृतश्च वीर्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: In strength and form, that bull among men was like a god; like the sun veiled by great banks of cloud, or a mighty fire covered with ashes.

verses.text:
तमापतन्तं प्रसमीक्ष्य पाण्डवं
विराटराडिन्दुमिवाभ्रसंवृतम् ।
मन्त्रिद्विजान्सूतमुखान्विशस्तथा
ये चापि केचित्परिषत्समासते ।
पप्रच्छ कोऽयं प्रथमं समेयिवा-
ननेन योऽयं प्रसमीक्षते सभाम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the Pandava approaching, like the moon wrapped in cloud, King Virata asked his counselors, the brahmins, the charioteers and bards, the common people and all who sat in the assembly: "Who is this that comes first, looking over the court?"

verses.text:
न तु द्विजोऽयं भविता नरोत्तमः
पतिः पृथिव्या इति मे मनोगतम् ।
न चास्य दासो न रथो न कुण्डले
समीपतो भ्राजति चायमिन्द्रवत् ॥

meaning.en: "He cannot be a brahmin; I think he is a prince among men, a lord of the earth. He has no servant, no chariot, no earrings, yet he shines near me like Indra."

verses.text:
शरीरलिङ्गैरुपसूचितो ह्ययं
मूर्धाभिषिक्तोऽयमितीव मानसम् ।
समीपमायाति च मे गतव्यथो
यथा गजस्तामरसीं मदोत्कटः ॥

meaning.en: "His bodily marks suggest it, and my heart says he is a crowned king. He comes up to me without fear, like a rutting elephant to a lotus pond."

verses.text:
वितर्कयन्तं तु नरर्षभस्तदा
युधिष्ठिरोऽभ्येत्य विराटमब्रवीत् ।
सम्राड्विजानात्विह जीवितार्थिनं
विनष्टसर्वस्वमुपागतं द्विजम् ॥

meaning.en: While Virata was thus musing, Yudhishthira, bull among men, came up and said: "Great king, know that I am a brahmin who has lost everything and come here seeking a livelihood."

verses.text:
इहाहमिच्छामि तवानघान्तिके
वस्तुं यथा कामचरस्तथा विभो ।
तमब्रवीत्स्वागतमित्यनन्तरं
राजा प्रहृष्टः प्रतिसंगृहाण च ॥

meaning.en: "I wish to live here, blameless king, near you, doing as I like, my lord." The king welcomed him gladly, saying "You are welcome; take your place."

verses.text:
कामेन ताताभिवदाम्यहं त्वां
कस्यासि राज्ञो विषयादिहागतः ।
गोत्रं च नामापि च शंस तत्त्वतः
किं चापि शिल्पं तव विद्यते कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: "Dear sir, I greet you gladly. From which king's land have you come? Tell me truly your lineage and name, and what craft you have practiced."

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
युधिष्ठिरस्यासमहं पुरा सखा
वैयाघ्रपद्यः पुनरस्मि ब्राह्मणः ।
अक्षान्प्रवप्तुं कुशलोऽस्मि देविता
कङ्केति नाम्नास्मि विराट विश्रुतः ॥

meaning.en: I was once a friend of Yudhishthira; I am a brahmin of the Vaiyaghrapadya line, skilled at throwing dice and fond of gaming; in Virata's land I am known as Kanka.

verses.text: विराट उवाच

meaning.en: Virata said:

verses.text:
ददामि ते हन्त वरं यमिच्छसि
प्रशाधि मत्स्यान्वशगो ह्यहं तव ।
प्रिया हि धूर्ता मम देविनः सदा
भवांश्च देवोपम राज्यमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: Gladly I give you any boon you wish. Rule the Matsyas; I am under your sway. Gamblers are always dear to me, and you, godlike man, deserve a kingdom.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
आप्तो विवादः परमो विशां पते
न विद्यते किंचन मत्स्य हीनतः ।
न मे जितः कश्चन धारयेद्धनं
वरो ममैषोऽस्तु तव प्रसादतः ॥

meaning.en: Lord of men, a quarrel over dice is the worst of all; but nothing is lacking in Matsya's land. Let no one I defeat keep his winnings; let that be my boon by your grace.

verses.text: विराट उवाच

meaning.en: Virata said:

verses.text:
हन्यामवध्यं यदि तेऽप्रियं चरे-
त्प्रव्राजयेयं विषयाद्द्विजांस्तथा ।
शृण्वन्तु मे जानपदाः समागताः
कङ्को यथाहं विषये प्रभुस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: I would kill, though he deserve no death, anyone who displeased you, and exile any brahmins who did so. Let the country people assembled here hear: as I am lord in this land, so is Kanka.

verses.text:
समानयानो भवितासि मे सखा
प्रभूतवस्त्रो बहुपानभोजनः ।
पश्येस्त्वमन्तश्च बहिश्च सर्वदा
कृतं च ते द्वारमपावृतं मया ॥

meaning.en: You shall share my carriage as my friend, with plenty of clothes, drink and food; you shall see everything, inside and outside, and I have opened my door to you.

verses.text:
ये त्वानुवादेयुरवृत्तिकर्शिता
ब्रूयाश्च तेषां वचनेन मे सदा ।
दास्यामि सर्वं तदहं न संशयो
न ते भयं विद्यति संनिधौ मम ॥

meaning.en: If any men, oppressed by lack of livelihood, come to you, speak to me for them; I shall give them everything. Have no fear while you are with me.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवं स लब्ध्वा तु वरं समागमं
विराटराजेन नरर्षभस्तदा ।
उवास वीरः परमार्चितः सुखी
न चापि कश्चिच्चरितं बुबोध तत् ॥

meaning.en: Having gained such a boon and such a meeting with King Virata, that hero, a bull among men, lived there happy and highly honored, and no one learned what lay behind it.
